action.name: HTML Framer
action.description: LOOM core bridge for turning uploaded static HTML ZIP packages into isolated project modules.

admin_settings.title: HTML Framer
admin_settings.description: Drop static HTML ZIP packages into LOOM. Each published frame becomes its own sandboxed LOOM module. LOOM discovers HTML/CSS/JS relationships, repairs safe local-path mistakes, and attaches orphan roots automatically.

fields.label: Enable HTML Framer modules
fields.help: When off, stored HTML frames remain preserved in the Instance Vault but are not added to the project runtime.

fields.label: Default new frame height
fields.help: Used for newly imported frames. Each frame can be adjusted independently afterward.
